Privacy Policy — Mastward

Last updated: 2026-11-24 · AXD Intelligence · Designed by Diego Nanini

Short version: Mastward runs on your own computer and your own phone. We do not collect your data. Data leaves your machine only for optional features you explicitly turn on: iPhone alerts, third-party cloud AI providers you choose and consent to, or explicit web research queries.

What we collect

Nothing about you. Mastward has no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, no advertising, no tracking SDKs, and no account on our servers. We do not see, receive or store:

  • your terminal sessions, commands, output or scrollback;
  • your keys, passwords, tokens or files;
  • your photos or camera images;
  • your computer names, addresses, or which devices you connect to;
  • any usage data.

Where your data lives

  • Your sessions run on your computer (the Mastward engine you install). History is stored locally on that computer.
  • Your phone talks directly to your own computer, over your home Wi-Fi or another connection you already have. Pairing needs your approval on the computer.
  • Camera and photos are used only when you choose to: to scan a pairing code, to send a picture from your phone to your own computer, or in the Capture tab. They are never sent to AXD servers, and photo analysis in the Capture tab runs only on local models on your own computer — Mastward will not send a captured photo to a cloud AI provider.
  • Microphone (hands-free voice control, optional, off until you turn it on): while it is on, short clips of your voice go from your phone to your own computer, which turns them into text there with a local speech model and then deletes the audio. Nothing is sent to AXD. If you pick the optional browser speech mode instead, your phone's own speech service (Apple on iPhone, Google on Android) turns your voice into text, under their privacy policy. Every voice command waits for you to tap Approve before anything is typed on your computer.
  • Device keys and any licence key are stored on your devices and checked offline.

Alerts on iPhone (optional)

If you turn on alerts on an iPhone, your computer sends the alert's title and text, together with your phone's Apple push token, through AXD's notification relay to Apple's push service, which delivers it to your phone. This is used only to deliver that alert. You can keep alert text private by leaving alerts off, and you can turn them off at any time in Settings → Alerts. Android does not use this relay.

Payment

If you buy a licence, payment is handled by the app store you bought it from, or directly between you and us. The app itself sends no payment data.

Third-party AI providers & web research (optional)

  • Local AI (default): When you use Local Ollama or on-device AI, your prompts, images, and files stay on your own computer/device. Local AI defaults to Local only (no automatic failover to cloud AI unless you opt in). Note: if you explicitly trigger deep research in Chat, Mastward runs keyless web queries from your computer to fetch public pages.
  • Cloud AI (BYO account / key): If you choose a third-party cloud provider (such as Claude by Anthropic, OpenAI/Codex, Gemini by Google, or Meta Muse), Mastward asks for your explicit permission before sending your first prompt to that provider. Prompts and any attached files then go directly from your computer to that provider under your own account/key and their privacy policy — never through AXD servers.
  • Flagged AI outputs: If you flag or report an AI response in-app, the report is saved privately on your own computer in Mastward's local data folder and is never uploaded to AXD servers.

Third parties

Mastward includes open-source components (see Third_party_notices.md); none of them collect or send your data to AXD. We do not sell your data; third-party transmission happens only for the optional features you explicitly enable above.

Children

Mastward is not directed at children under 13 (or 16, where local law says so).

Your rights

We hold no personal data about you, so there is nothing for us to access, correct or delete. Deleting the app removes its data from your phone; uninstalling the engine removes it from your computer. Questions: support@axdintelligence.com.au.
